title: scorer registry hydration: register, get and list must set scorer_version from the ScorerVersion entity, and Databricks responses may lack the attribute
answers: Why does get_scorer or list_scorers return a scorer whose version is None on Databricks?
How does a scorer returned from register_scorer learn its registered version?
Where is the scorer version set when loading a scorer from the tracking store?
I need to add a field to scheduled scorer responses; how do the Databricks and MLflow stores differ?
body:
Path: Scorer retrieval and registration in mlflow/genai/scorers/registry.py: the tracking-store backed registry (register_scorer, list_scorers, get_scorer, list_scorer_versions) and the Databricks-backed registry that talks to scheduled scorer endpoints. Both return Scorer objects to callers of mlflow.genai scorer register/get/list APIs.
Rule: The tracking-store path hydrates through _hydrate_scorer(scorer, scorer_version_entity, online_config), which takes the ScorerVersion entity and sets _experiment_id, _scorer_version and the sampling config from it. Pass the entity, not just the experiment id. On the Databricks path, read the version with getattr(response, _SCORER_VERSION_ATTRIBUTE, None) (the module constant, not a literal string) because older server responses may not include the field; register_scorer and update_registered_scorer read it from the response config directly.
Symptom: Scorers returned by get or list on Databricks had no registered version, so later assessments could not carry scorer provenance.
Constraints: The getattr fallback means a missing field yields None rather than an error; provenance is then simply absent. Local (tracking) scorers always get a version from the store.
applies: Scorer register, get, list and list-versions APIs across the tracking store and the Databricks scheduled-scorer backend in mlflow/genai/scorers/registry.py.
says: Registered evaluators show an empty version number when listed in the registry.
Retrieved scorers are missing their version details when viewed on cloud workspaces.
Evaluation assessments lack scorer version information needed to track provenance back to models.
Make sure registered scorers always display their assigned version after saving them.
Scorers fetched from the registry show blank version fields instead of numbers.
search: In mlflow/genai/scorers/registry.py, scorer retrieval and registration APIs must populate scorer_version on returned Scorer objects using the ScorerVersion entity or the backend response. The tracking-store backend hydrates via _hydrate_scorer(scorer, scorer_version_entity, online_config) to set _experiment_id, _scorer_version, and sampling config from the entity. The Databricks backend reads the version via getattr(response, _SCORER_VERSION_ATTRIBUTE, None) to safely handle older responses where the attribute is absent, while register_scorer and update_registered_scorer read from the response config. Applies to register_scorer, get_scorer, list_scorers, and list_scorer_versions across tracking and Databricks scheduled-scorer stores, allowing a missing Databricks version to yield None without failing.
